content: [Discord #external-counsel owen.park Mon Jan 26 10:00 UTC 2026] I've completed the full redline of v2.4. Key recommendation: The IP indemnification scope narrowing in v2.4 is UNACCEPTABLE as drafted. The 'security patch' exclusion could be weaponised to deny legitimate claims. Our revised position (v2.4-revised, attached): (1) IP indemnification REINSTATED to include all standard Everbridge-level options including procure rights — this supersedes the v2.4 narrowing; (2) The 'security patch' exclusion is struck; (3) Cap negotiation: we recommend pushing for 9 months minimum, 12 months preferred. The 6-month position is below the market standard documented in our analysis.
